De slechtste coach van Nederland, een minutendief en zelfs niet goed tegen studenten pratend, jij hebt gebreken.
red_flags: Only review source is Google Reviews (34 reviews, 4.8/5 aggregate); no presence on klantenvertellen, Trustpilot, Trustoo, ANWB/Tevreden, or Facebook.

Individual positive Google review bodies are JavaScript-rendered and could not be retrieved; only the single most-recent 1-star review body was scrapeable, so the captured corpus is one-sided by extraction limitation, not by cherry-picking.
The one readable review is a generic insult-driven 1-star with no concrete lesson detail beyond name-calling ('minutendief'), so its substance is low.
CBR official first-time practical pass rate at Den Bosch is ~48-49%, below the 54% location average; debesterijscholen.nl ranks Masto #22 locally at 45% pass rate (context, not review text).
Aggregate 4.8/5 from only 34 Google reviews is plausible but unverifiable at the text level with available tools.
review_summary: Rijschool Masto's only review footprint is Google Reviews (34 reviews, 4.8/5 aggregate per clickdrive/EduCar); there are no independent verified reviews (no klantenvertellen, Trustpilot, ANWB). Only one review body was actually readable, a recent 1-star Dutch review attacking a coach ('Talib') as a 'minutendief' (time-waster) and rude to students; the many positive reviews implied by the 4.8 score could not be read because their text is JS-rendered.
